mapper.sql: select id, keyword, enabled, remark, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from proj_mandate_rule
mapper.select:
where del_flag = '0'
and keyword like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')
and enabled = #{enabled}
order by enabled asc, id asc
select keyword from proj_mandate_rule where del_flag = '0' and enabled = '0' and keyword is not null and keyword != '' order by id
mapper.insert: insert into proj_mandate_rule (keyword, enabled, remark, del_flag, create_by, create_time) values (#{keyword}, #{enabled}, #{remark}, '0', #{createBy}, now())
mapper.update: update proj_mandate_rule set del_flag = '2', update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
